articles.summary: Lucky Strike Entertainment (NYSE: LUCK), one of the world’s premier owner/operators of location-based entertainment, today provided financial results for the first quarter of the 2027 fiscal year, which ended on September 27, 2026. Highlights: Total revenue increased 3.5% to $302.6 million versus 1Q26 Same-store revenue decreased 2.6% versus 1Q26 Net loss of $25.7 million versus net loss of $13.8 million in 1Q26 Adjusted EBITDA of $72.1 million versus $72.7 million in 1Q26 Net cash provided by operating activities of $17.1 million versus net cash used of $6.4 million in 1Q26 Capital expenditures of $21.5 million versus $25.9 million in 1Q26 Unveiled the refreshed AMF brand and converted 42 additional locations to the Lucky Strike brand during the quarter; 182 Lucky Strike locations as of November 5, 2026 Total locations in operation as of November 5, 2026, were 366 “Revenue grew in the first quarter, helped by our first full summer with two new water parks, and while same-store
articles.title: Lucky Strike Entertainment Reports First Quarter Results for Fiscal Year 2027

articles.summary: Lucky Strike Entertainment Corporation (NYSE: LUCK) (the "Company"), today announced that its Board of Directors (the "Board") has received a preliminary, non-binding proposal, dated November 16, 2026, from Thomas F. Shannon, the Company's Founder and Chief Executive Officer, to acquire all outstanding Class A Common Shares of the Company not already owned by Mr. Shannon and his affiliates for $4.35 per share (the "Proposal"). A copy of the Proposal letter has been filed by Mr. Shannon with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC") as Exhibit 99.9 to Amendment No. 3 to his Schedule 13D, filed on November 17, 2026, which is available on the SEC's website at www.sec.gov . The Board anticipates forming a special committee (the "Special Committee") to evaluate the Proposal. The Special Committee will have independent financial and legal advisors.
